title: Amazfit GTR
body:
Hi
When is going to be avaliable syncing with Amazfit GTR?
Thanks!!!!!

comments.body: right after you coded a plugin for it.

hello
i'm just a user, and need it too .. i have activated the Amazfit Service on Xdrip, but nothing s showing on the watch
would it be possible to replace the Step counter that appears on almost every watchface ? and put the BG Value instead ?

thanks !

No, but maybe it could be done with the weather widget, since theese data are coming from the watch.
But i don't have any of this incompatible watches to test it.
Thinking of getting a stratos 3 when its available. Maybe i can get it working with it in low power mode wich should be the same os as the GTR/GTS have. But this needs time

Hi, just started using xdrip with libre and miao miao and wanted to get a amazfit gtr.
I know that only stratos and pace are compatible in order to have the graph to a watchface but i was wondering if the gtr/gts can at least get the notifications about the glucose readings just like i have them on the phone.
Stratos and pace are too bulky for my small wrist. 
(i'm planing on buying GTR 42mm)

Hello. I got connection GTR and xdrip via miband menu. Put MAC of my GTR and restarted watch.
![Screenshot_20200923-222245](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33312884/94105012-93e91e80-fe62-11ea-8373-63a4b9933593.png)
Now I have notifications every 5 min. If someone could make watchscreen, placed to xdrip folder be able pull data to show graphic?
I would guess that a similar way like for miband should be possible. as soon as the gtr2 is available, i will into it.

@agniabakush that's brilliant!

So you were able to somehow solve this issue.

Care to share your findings?

Thank you in advance!

@twinko It's now possible do design watchfaces for gts2-mini, although I'm not a professional on it, it's possible using huami dev tools here:
https://dev.huami.com/watchface/index.html
![photo_2021-07-30_15-09-44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2041058/127694538-c2112913-982a-4636-ae0b-bc4abc964c0b.jpg)

Using this tool, it only export an .bin file, looking at it's header it seems that it's like miband5 header, but I'm not sure how can I define the header size.
I've tried to use it as a custom watchface but it's not working yet.
I've seen other people asking for this integration, and I can commit my code to the github, but I'm not sure if this need to be done here at this repository, or at @bigdigital xdrip repository. Is the Artem code merged here?
